title: Validation Notice Timetable by Placement Stage, Placed Consumer Accounts
content:
Compliance timetable for the validation notice on **Placed Consumer Accounts**. For each placement stage it gives the sending deadline, whether email delivery is available at the stage, the assumed-receipt buffer, the length of the validation period and the date used as the itemization date on the notice.

| Stage | Notice sent within (business days after the placement date) | Email delivery available at the stage | Assumed-receipt buffer (business days after sending) | Validation period (calendar days after assumed receipt) | Itemization date shown on the notice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Early-Out Placement | 2 | Yes | 5 | 30 | Last statement date |
| Primary Placement | 3 | Yes | 5 | 30 | Charge-off date |
| Secondary Placement | 3 | Yes | 5 | 30 | Charge-off date |
| Tertiary Placement | 3 | No | 5 | 30 | Charge-off date |
| Warehouse Placement | 5 | No | 5 | 30 | Charge-off date |
| Legal Review Placement | 2 | No | 5 | 30 | Charge-off date |

## What each column means

- **Notice sent within**: the number of business days after the placement date within which the validation notice must be sent.
- **Email delivery available**: whether the validation notice may be delivered by email at that stage. Where the column reads "No", the notice is mailed.
- **Assumed-receipt buffer**: the number of business days after sending on which Ridgeline assumes the consumer received the notice.
- **Validation period**: the calendar days the validation period runs after the assumed receipt date.
- **Itemization date**: the reference date printed as the itemization date on the notice, either the last statement date or the charge-off date.

## Points of comparison between stages

- Every stage uses the same assumed-receipt buffer (5 business days) and the same validation period (30 calendar days); the stages differ in the sending deadline, in email availability and, for Early-Out Placement alone, in the itemization date.
- The shortest sending deadline, 2 business days, applies at Early-Out Placement and Legal Review Placement; the longest, 5 business days, at Warehouse Placement.
- Email delivery of the notice is available only at Early-Out Placement, Primary Placement and Secondary Placement.
